name: Silk Home: Echoes of the Forbidden
summary: SILK HOME: ECHOES OF THE FORBIDDEN is a surreal puzzle blending Chinese alchemy with horror. Audit Yan Song's shattered mind, weave cursed silk on bone looms, and sync pulse resonance under the Emperor's gaze. Collect memory cubes to break the Ming cycle or embrace a painful awakening.
